metadata.description: agentjoey's collection of Claude tools and skills.

plugins.name: behavior-driven-testing
plugins.description: Test at the real boundary with real data and probe the running system before claiming a feature works. A green gate is not 'works'.

plugins.name: linear-roadmap-maintenance
plugins.description: Make Linear the work queue: pull the top backlog issue by priority, work it, close it in the same session. Reconciliation is the repair path, gated so it costs nothing when the loop is working.

plugins.name: intake-workflow
plugins.description: Keep Linear free of undiscussed and never-finished issues: discuss needs in Notion first, create a Linear issue only after the Owner confirms, write one closing record per finished Milestone. Ships the rule block each repo carries and a script to render, check and apply it.

plugins.name: engineering-conventions
plugins.description: Stop the shared engineering rules from drifting between repos and from being invisible to the harness that needs them: one canonical block, written to the one file codex, kimi, agy, opencode and Claude Code all read, compared byte for byte instead of by eye.
